title: Stern, Then Soft
caption_hook: Tough on what hurts you. Gentle with you.

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, three-quarter-length framing from the reference portrait, with one slow, small push-in throughout and the crown and golden sun disc centered and fully framed.
shots.action: Her brows are lowered and Her jaw firm in a stern, guarding stare held on the viewer, and over the clip the stare gradually eases into a faint, tender smile as the vertical third eye brightens softly with a silver-blue glow. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: Face-only fallback: a single continuous change of expression with one light response.
